title: Signup Validation - Age Restriction
description: Attempt to sign up with age < 18 (e.g., age 17). Verify server rejects with status 422 or 400 validation error.
expected_result: API rejects registration and returns error indicating age must be at least 18.
comments: Successfully verified via pytest boundary testing.

title: Signup Validation - Duplicate Email
description: Attempt to sign up twice using the same email address. Verify duplicate email error (status 400).
expected_result: API rejects duplicate email with status 400 and message 'Email already registered'.
comments: Successfully verified via duplicate email regression checks.

title: Signup Success
description: Verify registration works for a new user with valid name, age, email, password, phone, and interests.
expected_result: User registered successfully, token and public profile returned, status 200.

title: Login Validation - Empty Fields
description: Attempt login with empty email or empty password. Verify API returns validation errors.
expected_result: API returns 422 Unprocessable Entity for missing required body fields.

title: Login Validation - Incorrect Password
description: Attempt login with a registered email but wrong password. Verify HTTP 401 response.
expected_result: API returns status 401 Unauthorized with message 'Invalid email or password'.

title: Login Success
description: Verify login returns a valid JWT token and public profile for a registered user.
expected_result: Successful login with valid token and matching user info.

title: Token Persistence
description: Verify AsyncStorage stores token key 'safeconnect_token' upon successful login.
expected_result: AsyncStorage.setItem is called with 'safeconnect_token' and token value.
comments: Verified via AsyncStorage mock interface checks.

title: Token Validity check
description: Verify token decoding on server using PyJWT and HS256 matches expected payload.
expected_result: Server successfully decodes payload, extracts user id, and validates expiration.

title: Get Profile endpoint (/auth/me)
description: Retrieve profile using valid token. Verify API returns public user details.
expected_result: Response contains user name, email, phone, avatar, verified status, rating.

title: UI/UX - Brand Colors & Logo styling
description: Verify logo and title display as 'saFeConnect' with feminine pink/rose styling.
expected_result: Title text displays 'saFeConnect' with style colored '#ff4d6d'.
comments: Verified on web landing screen rendering.

title: UI/UX - Background gradient check
description: Verify background uses light cream/blush gradient and does not contain dark purple.
expected_result: Page container style has background color '#fff5f7'.
comments: Color palette verified on screen container styling.

title: UI/UX - Onboarding skip option layout
description: Verify skip button exists on onboarding and immediately directs user to Login screen.
expected_result: Skip button matches theme and moves router stack to login screen.

title: UI/UX - Password toggle visibility check
description: Verify click on eye icon toggles the secureTextEntry property of the password input.
expected_result: Eye icon toggle successfully changes secureTextEntry true/false.

title: Validation - Malformed Email checks
description: Attempt signup with malformed emails (e.g. 'test@example', 'test.com'). Verify validation error.
expected_result: EmailStr validator in SignupReq pydantic schema raises Validation error.

title: Validation - Route Auth protection
description: Access profile /auth/me without Bearer token. Verify HTTP 401 is returned.
expected_result: Response yields status code 401 and message 'Missing token'.

title: Profile Update - Name change
description: Update user name via PATCH /api/auth/me and verify change persists in MongoDB.
expected_result: User name updated to new value and matches subsequent GET request.
comments: Successfully verified via profile patch tests.

title: Profile Update - Bio change
description: Update bio field and check that the new bio text is saved correctly.
expected_result: User bio text updated and returned in public profile details.

title: Profile Update - Interests list modification
description: Modify the user interests array via profile edit. Verify the list saves correctly.
expected_result: Interests array contains new elements and is persisted correctly.

title: Profile Update - Languages list modification
description: Modify spoken languages list and check that updates persist.
expected_result: Languages list updated and saved in user profile records.

title: Safety Score display
description: Verify default user profile safety score displays as 85.
expected_result: Safety score defaults to 85 upon user account creation.
comments: Verified via seed default value verification.

title: Trips count display
description: Verify trips_count defaults to 0 and increments dynamically when trips are created.

title: Countries visited display
description: Verify countries_visited defaults to 0 in public profile details.
expected_result: countries_visited key is present and defaults to 0.
comments: Verified via database query schema default.

title: Profile avatar rendering
description: Verify custom avatar URL renders properly or falls back to standard placeholder.
expected_result: Image element renders source URI correctly.

title: ID verification data storage
description: Verify base64 verification ID image and selfie image upload properties are saved in DB.
expected_result: id_image_b64 and selfie_b64 properties stored under user document.

title: Verification status flag update
description: Verify user.verified is set to true automatically if ID + selfie details are supplied.
expected_result: verified flag sets to true in output of Signup API response.

title: UI/UX - Profile Layout check
description: Verify profile navigation structure and bio rendering alignments.
expected_result: User name and safety score badges are aligned.

title: UI/UX - Keyboard avoiding view
description: Verify inputs do not hide behind virtual keyboard on mobile edit profile screen.
expected_result: ScrollView enables scrolling up to access lower form fields.

title: Validation - Range restriction on Age update
description: Attempt to update age to 105 or 15 via PATCH user. Verify API rejects input.
expected_result: PATCH fails validation check or retains valid parameters.

title: Start Chat with another user
description: Initialize a chat session via POST /api/chats/start. Check chat session created.
expected_result: Chat session created or retrieved, returns unique chat ID, status 200.

title: Retrieve active chats list
description: Get inbox contents via GET /api/chats. Verify it contains started chats.
expected_result: Inbox returns list of chat documents representing conversations.

title: Send chat message text
description: Send a text message via POST /api/chats/messages. Verify text, sender id are logged.
expected_result: Message saved under chat ID, returns message structure.

title: Retrieve messages history
description: Fetch messages list using GET /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages.
expected_result: Returns list of chat message text elements sorted in time.

title: Retrieve messages incremental check (after timestamp)
description: Retrieve messages after specific timestamp. Check only newer messages return.
expected_result: Returns list with messages matching timestamp criteria.

title: Chat preview text verification
description: Verify last_message and last_at are updated in chat listing on new message.
expected_result: Inbox response details show updated preview text.

title: Validation - Chat access authorization
description: Attempt to get messages of another user's chat session. Verify 404 response.

title: Validation - Reject empty messages
description: Send message with empty text. Verify validation error.
expected_result: Validation fails on empty inputs, returns error.

title: UI/UX - Message bubbles rendering
description: Verify incoming messages bubble displays on left and outgoing on right.
expected_result: Layout displays correct bubble color styles and alignments.

title: UI/UX - Chat inputs styling
description: Verify presence of message text input box and send icon inside active chat window.
expected_result: Input bar stays at bottom and displays text correctly.

title: UI/UX - Header avatar icon
description: Verify chat partner avatar renders in top navigation header.
expected_result: Navigation bar displays username and partner thumbnail picture.

title: Validation - Chat chronological sort order
description: Verify messages list returns in strict chronological order.
expected_result: Index sequence matches increasing created_at times.

title: Retrieve suggested travellers list
description: Verify retrieval of suggested travellers list via GET /api/travellers/suggested.
expected_result: List returns nearby active women travellers profiles.

title: Filter suggested travellers by destination
description: Filter suggestions by adding destination parameter. Verify output filtered correctly.
expected_result: Only travellers having trips matching Lisbon destination are returned.

title: Exclusion of self in suggestions check
description: Verify suggested list does not return current logged-in user profile.
expected_result: Current user ID is excluded from suggestions response.

title: Create match request with message
description: Send match request to another traveller with intro message via POST /api/matches/request.
expected_result: Match request registered, status set to pending.

title: Validation - Block matching yourself
description: Send match request with target_user_id equal to current user id. Verify 400 rejection.
expected_result: Server rejects request with 400 Bad Request.

title: Retrieve incoming pending matches
description: Retrieve active pending match requests received by the current user.
expected_result: Incoming list contains match request from source user along with profile.

title: Accept incoming match request
description: Accept a pending match request. Verify match status updates to 'accepted' in DB.

title: Decline incoming match request
description: Decline match request. Verify status updates to 'declined'.

title: Idempotent matching request validation
description: Send duplicate match requests to the same target user. Verify duplicates are skipped/idempotent.
expected_result: Second request returns existing match status instead of adding duplicate.

title: Suggested profile details checks
description: Verify suggestion output includes user latest_trip fields correctly.
expected_result: latest_trip is nested under suggested user profile object.

title: UI/UX - Suggested profiles rendering list check
description: Verify layout of suggested users list, showing bio and safety score badges.
expected_result: Cards display user details, badges, and verified status icon correctly.

title: UI/UX - Matching action buttons feedback
description: Verify visual feedback when Accept/Decline action buttons are clicked.
expected_result: Buttons hide or show state changes to 'accepted' / 'declined'.

title: UI/UX - Match request modal checks
description: Verify modal triggers with input text area when Request Match is clicked.
expected_result: Modal displays matching user detail and message text fields.

title: Validation - Verify resolved match lists
description: Verify declined match requests no longer show in active incoming queue.
expected_result: Declined items filtered out from pending incoming list.

title: Create Feed Post
description: Create a post with caption, image URL, and location via POST /api/posts.

title: Retrieve Feed Posts list
description: Retrieve feed posts using GET /api/posts. Verify newer posts show.
expected_result: Returns list of posts including creator profile details.

title: Like active Feed Post
description: Like a post via POST /api/posts/{post_id}/like. Verify liked field sets to true.

title: Unlike active Feed Post (Toggle)

title: Add Comment to Feed Post

title: Retrieve post Comments list

title: Post details author mapping checks

title: Like counts increment check

title: Comment counts increment check
